Container.Name: Monido
Container.Overview: Monido tracks your net worth and cash flow, on your own or as a family. Enter monthly balances, income and expenses by hand (no bank connections), close the month, and see net worth, loans, property, goals and financial health in one dashboard. An optional AI advisor lets Claude weigh a purchase, a loan or a goal against your own numbers and file bank statements into the month after your yes. One container, SQLite, English and Russian.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: finance budget net-worth cash-flow family money self-hosted claude mcp

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: HTTP port of the web interface.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: The SQLite database and its backups. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the data folder (Unraid: nobody = 99).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the data folder (Unraid: users = 100).

Config.Name: APP_URL
Config.Description: Optional: the https:// address the app is reached at (needed for Telegram sign-in and Claude's connector).

Config.Name: CLIENT_IP_HEADER
Config.Description: Optional, behind a reverse proxy: the header with the client address (X-Forwarded-For, CF-Connecting-IP).
